AAMI.name: Acadian Asset Management Inc.
AAMI.description: Acadian Asset Management Inc. is a publicly owned asset management holding company. The firm provides its services to individuals and institutions. It manages separate client focused portfolios through its subsidiaries. The firm also launches equity mutual funds for its clients. It invests in public equity, fixed income, and alternative investment markets through its subsidiaries. The firm was founded in 1980 is based Boston, Massachusetts. It was formally known as BrightSphere Investment Group plc. Acadian Asset Management Inc. was formed in 1980 and is based in Boston, Massachusetts.

items.name: 잉여현금흐름/매출
items.note: 영업으로 실제 남는 현금. 마이너스면 외부 자금(증자·차입)에 의존

items.name: 영업이익률
items.note: 본업 수익성. 10% 이상이면 스크리너 장기 기준 통과

items.name: 매출 성장(yoy)
items.note: 최근 분기 매출의 전년 대비 성장

items.name: ROE
items.note: 자본 대비 이익. 15% 이상이면 스크리너 장기 기준 통과

items.name: 순이익률
items.note: 매출에서 최종적으로 남는 비율
